title: 26 Languages Disappear Each Year—Far Faster Than Before
hook: 26 languages disappear each year, far faster than before.
closing: Every lost language erases knowledge, memory, and a distinct way of seeing.
question: Which languages do you speak?

segments.say: About 40 percent of languages are endangered or dying. Their last speakers carry entire cultures.
Today, 26 languages disappear each year. Language loss has accelerated sharply.
Only 3,500 languages are projected to remain. Half of today's linguistic diversity could vanish.
